title: Skeletal Wyvern

additionalFacts.text: An elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward or ancient wyvern shield reduces icy breath damage.
support: elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield to reduce damage from their icy breath
it is not required to be slain
